source: Unmodified live PPC512 B800 text video memory, read through ELKS /dev/kmem; rendered with previously captured PPC BIOS font
commands_on_console: Existing user console: fdisk -l, mount -t msdos /dev/ssd1 /mnt/usb, mount
capture_actions: Read mount table through telnet, dump 4000 bytes of video memory to internal /tmp, retrieve through FTP; no USB writes, remount, reboot, or console repaint
note: Existing fdisk interpretation of the flat MINIX internal hda image prints bogus partition rows; preserved as actual output, not a USB partition error.
